title: Heart
label: ch:mr-heart
canDo: I can name the heart in Marathi, name three English words that share its root, and say what makes it different from every other word this book has taken apart: it never drifted at all.

payoff.summary: The reader produces हृदय and its three secure English cousins — heart, cordial, cardiac — then sets it against वाचणे's drift from speaking to reading, समजणे's drift from waking to understanding, and डोळा's replacement of the old eye-word, naming हृदय as the one word among them that never drifted at all.
